newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Land unit loan upped to HK$6 bln.
newsitem.headline: HK Land unit loan upped to HK$6 bln.

text.p: Hongkong Land Property Co Ltd, a subsidiary of Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd has boosted its HK$3.6 billion syndicated loan to HK$6 billion, Hongkong Land said on Wednesday.
The loan was in two-tranches -- a five-year tranche for HK$3.3 billion, and a seven-year HK$2.7 billion tranche.
"The loan... will help the group to achieve a longer debt maturity profile," Hongkong Land finance director Ian Durant said in a statement after the signing.
Coordinating arrangers for the deal were HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Chase Manhattan Asia and Societe Generale Asia.
Senior arrangers and senior lead managers were as follows:

HongkongBank, Societe Generale Hong Kong branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, Commerz (East Asia), Development Bank of Singapore, Sakura Bank, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong branch and Westdeutsche Landesbank.
Arrangers and lead managers are as follows:
Bank of Nova Scotia, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Hong Kong branch, Daiwa Bank Hong Kong branch, Standard Chartered Bank and Sumitomo Bank.
Co-arranger and expanded lead manager is Tokai Bank, Hong Kong branch.
Den Danske Bank Hong Kong branch, Hamburgische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp Hong Kong branch and National Australia Bank.
CARIPLO Hong Kong branch, DG Bank Deutsche Genossenschaftsbank Hong Kong branch, Industrial Bank of Japan Hong Kong branch and Toyo Trust and Banking Co Hong Kong branch.
Societe Generale Asia is the agent.
